title: Fold the repeated setup into TEST_F
summary: Copied GoogleTest setup moves into a fixture. TEST and TEST_F cannot share one test suite.

turns.user: the first 3 lines of every test in cart_test are copy paste. fix it

assistant.body: Great catch. Those lines belong in a TEST_F fixture. Members of a class derived from ::testing::Test are built fresh for every test, so no test can leak state into another. I added it right after the includes and rewrote StartsEmpty. The remaining TEST cases keep working as they are.

turns.user: everything fails. All tests in the same test suite must use the same test fixture class. keep working huh

assistant.body: Apologies, my previous answer was not accurate. Inside the CartTest suite, TEST uses ::testing::Test as its fixture and TEST_F uses CartTest, and GoogleTest rejects the mix at run time. The rest become TEST_F too, and the three local lines go so the tests use the members.
sed -i '' 's/^TEST(CartTest,/TEST_F(CartTest,/; /^  Inventory inventory;$/d; /^  inventory\.add("apple", 3);$/d; /^  Cart cart(inventory);$/d; s/\([ (]\)cart\./\1cart_./g' tests/cart_test.cpp

turns.user: passes. do we even need SetUp? why not the constructor. idk

assistant.body: Short answer: both work, but the GoogleTest FAQ suggests the constructor first. Reach for SetUp only when the setup needs ASSERT_ macros or has to call a virtual function. Here it only calls add, so it moves into the constructor.
